title: Learning Navigator

hero.headline: Turn a pile of educational media into a path a learner can actually traverse.
hero.support: A structured navigation layer for courses, videos, articles, and learning collections that makes prerequisites, dependencies, depth changes, alternate paths, disagreement, and the next admissible learning step visible.

sections.heading: Abundance is not navigation
sections.body: A large corpus can contain the right material and still fail a learner when ordering, prerequisites, conceptual gaps, and reasons for progression remain implicit.

sections.heading: Map dependencies
sections.body: Represent what a learner needs before an object becomes useful, what it unlocks afterward, and where alternate explanations or routes exist.

sections.heading: Preserve the underlying creators
sections.body: The navigator organizes and contextualizes an existing educational corpus rather than replacing the source material.

sections.heading: Make the next step explainable
sections.body: Recommendations should state why an item is next: prerequisite repair, depth transition, alternate representation, application, review, or branch choice.

sections.heading: Measure transfer
sections.body: A useful pilot tests path completion, comprehension, confidence, and whether learners can use the concept outside the original sequence.

pilot.shape: Map one bounded video series or course into prerequisites, alternate paths, missing bridges, and depth transitions.
